snippet.title: Nonozle - a nonogram game - 4K trailer
snippet.description:
Nonozle is an upcoming game with 200 hand-made nonograms, the type of puzzle featured in games like Picross. It will be available to buy on Steam and Itch.io on August 12.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2053580

Game website:
https://nonozle.com
